feature: Optional Grouping Toggle + Camera Angle Fix
description: Two changes: (1) Default view puts ALL items on shared shelf rows (no category grouping). A toggle button switches to grouped-by-type view. (2) Camera angles are adjusted so no shelf is viewed from a steep up/down angle — every shelf should feel like you're looking at it roughly at eye level or with a gentle downward tilt.

angle_issue.current_behavior: 4 shelves stacked at y=0, 3, 6, 9. Camera at y=4.5, z~12. Bottom shelf (Projects, y=0) is viewed steeply from above. Top shelf (Rewards, y=9) is viewed from below, looking upward. The further a shelf is from camera center, the more distorted the viewing angle.
angle_issue.root_cause: SHELF_SPACING_Y = 3.0 is too large relative to camera distance. Combined with FOV 45°, this creates extreme perspective foreshortening at the top and bottom shelves.
angle_issue.user_feedback: Projects angle is 'too much'. Mobilities viewed 'from way too bottom'. User likes the varying-angle shelf effect but wants it subtle.

grouping_issue.current_behavior: Items are always grouped by category, one shelf per category. This creates 4 shelves for 4 items — feels sparse.
grouping_issue.desired_behavior: Default: all items mixed on shared shelves (max 5 per row). Optional: toggle to group by type with category labels.

change_1_view_modes.description: Add two view modes: 'all' (default) and 'grouped'. A toggle button switches between them. The scene rebuilds shelves and replaces items with an animation.

view_mode_all.description: All items on shared shelves, sorted by date (newest right). No category labels. Mixed shapes on same shelf.
view_mode_all.shelf_logic: Total items / MAX_PER_ROW rows. Items sorted globally by date ascending.
view_mode_all.labels: None — no labels in this mode.

view_mode_grouped.description: Current behavior — one shelf section per category, each with a label.
view_mode_grouped.shelf_logic: Same as current buildShelves() — group by itemType, one shelf per category.
view_mode_grouped.labels: Category labels on left edge of each category's first shelf row.

toggle_button.html_location: Inside the works-header section, below the description paragraph

behavior.when_mode_is_all: Button text says 'Group by type'. Clicking switches to grouped mode.
behavior.when_mode_is_grouped: Button text says 'Show all'. Clicking switches to all mode.

styling.appearance: Minimal pill button matching theme. No background fill — just a border + text. On hover: subtle fill.

transition_animation.description: When switching modes, items scale down to 0, shelves/labels are removed and rebuilt, items scale back up.
steps: 2. Scale all existing item groups to 0 over 300ms (lerp in animate loop)
3. Once all at scale 0: remove all itemGroups, shelfMeshes, labelSprites from scene. Dispose geometry/materials.
4. Clear the arrays: itemGroups = [], shelfMeshes = [], labelSprites = []
5. Call buildShelves() with new mode logic
6. Call placeItems() — items start at scale 0 with entrance animation
7. Recalculate camera position for new shelf layout
transition_animation.note: The entrance animation from placeItems() handles the scale-up. Total transition feels ~600ms.

change_2_camera_angles.description: Reduce vertical spacing and adjust camera to ensure every shelf is viewed from a comfortable, near-level angle. The gentle variation in viewing angle per shelf is preserved but capped.

SHELF_SPACING_Y.reason: Tighter spacing reduces the vertical spread. With 4 shelves, total height goes from 9.0 to 6.0 — much less extreme angles at top/bottom.

CAMERA_FOV.reason: Lower FOV compresses perspective, making shelves at different heights feel more similar in angle. Compensated by pulling camera back slightly.

new_camera_positioning.description: Camera is positioned slightly above center and further back. This creates a gentle overall downward tilt (like looking at a wall shelf from standing height), and no shelf is at an extreme angle.

formula.note: The +0.5 on Y raises the camera slightly above center, giving a natural 'standing and looking at wall shelves' feel. The Z is further back with a gentler per-row multiplier.

new_camera_positioning.note: lookAt targets the true center (not the raised camera Y), creating the gentle downward tilt.

implementation_steps.action: Refactor buildShelves() to support both modes
implementation_steps.change: Add a 'mode' parameter to buildShelves(items, mode). When mode === 'all': sort all items by date, distribute across rows of MAX_PER_ROW, no labels. When mode === 'grouped': existing behavior (group by category, add labels). Return shelfMap in both cases.

mode_all_logic: 1. Sort all items by date ascending
3. For each row r (0 to totalRows-1):
- Create shelf at y = r * SHELF_SPACING_Y
- shelfMap['all'] = [{ y, startIndex: r*5, endIndex: min((r+1)*5, items.length) }]

implementation_steps.verify: buildShelves(items, 'all') creates correct number of rows. buildShelves(items, 'grouped') still works as before.

implementation_steps.action: Refactor placeItems() to support both modes
implementation_steps.change: Add a 'mode' parameter. When mode === 'all': iterate shelfMap['all'] rows, place items in date order regardless of type. When mode === 'grouped': existing behavior.

mode_all_logic: 1. Sort all items by date ascending
- Place on shelf using same spacing formula
- Each item still gets its correct shape via createShape(item.itemType, ...)

implementation_steps.verify: In 'all' mode, all 4 sample items appear on one shelf row, mixed shapes, sorted by date.

implementation_steps.change: Extract the row-counting logic from initScene() into a helper function computeRowCount(items, mode) so it can be reused during mode transitions.
implementation_steps.verify: Helper returns correct count for both modes.

implementation_steps.change: New function that removes and disposes all item groups, shelf meshes, and label sprites from the scene. Clears the arrays. Does NOT touch the camera, lights, or renderer.
logic: itemGroups.forEach(g => { scene.remove(g); g.traverse(c => { if(c.geometry) c.geometry.dispose(); if(c.material) { if(c.material.map) c.material.map.dispose(); c.material.dispose(); } }); });
implementation_steps.verify: After calling clearScene(), scene only has lights remaining.

implementation_steps.action: Smooth camera transition on mode switch
implementation_steps.change: Instead of snapping camera to new position, lerp it in animate(). Add targetCameraY, targetCameraZ, targetLookAtY variables. In animate(): camera.position.y += (targetCameraY - camera.position.y) * 0.05; same for Z. lookAtTarget.y lerps similarly.

testing_checklist: Default view: all items on shared shelves, no category labels
Toggle button visible and styled as minimal pill
Click 'Group by type': items scale out, shelves rebuild grouped with labels, items scale in
Click 'Show all': reverse transition back to mixed view
No shelf viewed from extreme angle in either mode
With 1 shelf (all mode, ≤5 items): nearly level viewing angle
With 4 shelves (grouped mode): gentle angle variation, no steep perspectives
Camera smoothly transitions between positions on mode switch
Toggle button disabled during transition (no double-click)
All existing features still work: hover, tooltip, click, entrance animation, dark mode, parallax, mobile fallback
Mobile fallback grid unchanged (no toggle needed — already shows grouped)
